claim_text: Singer Dolly Parton became the legal guardian of an abandoned newborn baby and promised to cover all of the child's living expenses until they reach age 18.
query: Singer Dolly Parton became the legal guardian of an abandoned newborn baby
summary: Rating: In August and September 2026, social media users recirculated a rumor claiming that country music legend Dolly Parton became the legal guardian of an abandoned newborn and promised to cover the child's living expenses until age 18. When we investigated the rumor in May 2025, an analysis using Hive, an AI-detection platform, concluded with 100% certainty that the images were "likely to be AI-generated." (Facebook user NCIS Daily News, Hive) However, one photograph included in a collage spreading with the rumor in 2026 was real. Father and son are together at Dilley [Immigration Processing Center]." The DHS has called the mainstream narrative a "horrific smear pushed by the media and anti-ICE activists," and claimed the agents got the boy food from McDonald’s and played his favorite music to comfort him.
